_help: Settings for the admin dashboard (admin/). vetting: the checklist shown on each project request before you approve it. statusNames: the words shown for each request status.

vetting.text: Team is public or verifiably known
Product or testnet is live and works
Contracts audited, or no token contracts yet
No promises of prices or returns in their materials
No history of rugs, hacks left unpaid or fake claims
Course or toy content is accurate and educational
